_comment: Voices the office offers. id = <engine>:<name>. role: system (the HQ's own voice), lead (AM7), crew (operational hackers), any. VoiceStudio presets are designed voices (VoxCPM2 voice design: a description plus a fixed seed, so a voice sounds the same every time); 'fallback' is the Silero voice spoken when VoiceStudio is down.

voices.label: AM7
voices.description: Главный хакер: низкий спокойный мужской голос

params.description: A deep, calm, confident adult male voice with a low pitch, measured pace and clear, precise diction; composed and authoritative, like a commander giving a briefing.
A young adult male voice, energetic and quick, slightly bright tone, focused and professional.
A mature male baritone, dry and matter-of-fact, steady pace, low emotion.
A male voice in his thirties, precise and analytical, medium pitch, crisp articulation.
A confident adult female voice, cool and composed, medium-low pitch, clear diction.
A young adult female voice, lively and sharp, slightly fast pace, professional tone.
